name: Expo
description: Expo's hosted server answers from Expo's documentation and, signed in, reads EAS builds, updates and project settings.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.expo.dev) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
